# Kaio Silveira

> Software architect in Lisbon, building at Bloqit. Architecture decisions are bets: I make them explicit, test the risky ones, and write down what would change my mind.

## Selected work

- [Refactoring](https://github.com/kaiosilveira/refactoring): Fowler's 61 refactorings (2nd ed.) step by step, with diffs and tests.
- [Stability patterns](https://github.com/kaiosilveira/stability-patterns): Release It! patterns in TypeScript, with load tests and fault injection for circuit breaker and let it crash.
- [Design patterns](https://github.com/kaiosilveira/design-patterns): All 23 GoF patterns in C#, with diagrams and tests.
- [Test-driven development](https://github.com/kaiosilveira/test-driven-development): Beck's TDD by Example, one pull request per chapter.
